name: Under the Hood: Data Science and AI summer program (formerly Run the World: AI Explorers)
org: University of Minnesota Data Science and AI Hub
what_you_do: Learn Python and build models that make guesses from real data, like sports and nature data. Week 2 covers neural networks, computer vision and AI that makes new things. You use UMN labs and hear from researchers.
who_can_apply: Rising 11th and 12th graders. You do not need to know how to code. Week 1 is required before Week 2.
pay_detail: Summer 2026 cost: $125 for Week 1 and $175 for Week 2. The page does not mention aid.
duration: 1 or 2 weeks, 8:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. each day
deadline_text: Summer 2026: Week 1 was July 13 to 17 and Week 2 was July 20 to 24, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Register link on the program page when the next summer is posted.
notes: Day program at Keller and Tate Halls. The UMN science and engineering camps page still calls it Run the World: AI Explorers and says rising 9th and 10th graders may be let in case by case. Not a job.
